unit_note: all amounts 百万円 as disclosed, truncated below the unit (記載単位未満切捨て). Recomputation tolerance = number of truncated input terms (each true value lies in [x, x+1)).
aggregation_operator: sqrt(x^T R x) with x = vector of risk amounts in the stated id order and R = the matrix; non-negative inputs; null (dash) = 0

top.article: kokuji74 第百五十五条 (via 第四十五条第一項第一号イ)
top.then: insurance_business_rc_before_MA_excess = sqrt(x^T R x) + rc_operational  (オペレーショナル・リスクは相関統合の外で線形加算, 第百五十五条 末尾)

operational.value: min(上限適用前オペリスク, 0.20 × (top_sqrt + rc_mgmt_action_excess))

pre_cap_components.nonlife: max(2.75% × 当年度収入保険料, 2.75% × (現在推計 + 複製可能契約評価額)) + 2.75% × max(0, 当年度収入保険料 − 1.2 × 前年度収入保険料)
pre_cap_components.life_with_risk: max(4% × 収入保険料, 0.45% × (現在推計 + 複製可能契約評価額)) + 4% × max(0, 収入保険料 − 1.2 × 前年度収入保険料)
pre_cap_components.life_unit_linked: 0.40% × (現在推計 + 複製可能契約評価額)

operational.note: pre-cap inputs (premiums, current estimate by contract class) are not in the disclosure form → only the cap can be checked from disclosed figures. au Non-Life FY2025: F=251 vs cap 251.5 → binding at the cap.

management_action_excess.article: kokuji74 第四十六条第三項
management_action_excess.value: max(0, RC_ins(MA未考慮, op=0) − RC_ins(MA考慮, op=0) − 将来の裁量給付に係る正味現在推計)
management_action_excess.note: added linearly to 所要資本（税効果考慮前）; both FY2025 samples print a dash (0)

diversification.article: kokuji75 別紙様式第三号 記載上の注意 6(5)
diversification.definition: Σ(rc_life, rc_nonlife, rc_catastrophe, rc_market, rc_credit, rc_operational) − (top_sqrt + rc_operational)
diversification.simplifies_to: Σ(rc_life, rc_nonlife, rc_catastrophe, rc_market, rc_credit) − top_sqrt

pre_tax.article: kokuji75 別紙様式第三号 row (J) / kokuji74 第四十五条第一項

non_insurance.note: 単体ベースでは 0 (第四十五条第一項第二号); row (I) deleted from the solo form unless 子会社株式特例手法

tax_effect.article: kokuji74 第百五十六条第一号 (単体ベース)
tax_effect.definition: min( 0.80 × 法定実効税率 × (top_sqrt + rc_operational + rc_mgmt_action_excess) , [0.50 × 法定実効税率 × Σ直近5期税引前当期純利益]+ + [DTL − DTA]+ − min([DTA − DTL]+, 0.15 × (top_sqrt + rc_operational + rc_mgmt_action_excess)) ), floored at 0

statutory_effective_tax_rate.regulation: company-specific 法定実効税率 (財務諸表等規則の定義, 第三十五条第二項) — the notice fixes no number
statutory_effective_tax_rate.note: both FY2025 samples reproduce K exactly as trunc(0.80 × 0.28 × J): au 338.2→338, MY 1564.6→1564, i.e. branch 1 binds with t=28.0%. In October, K/J/0.8 outside 0.27–0.31 means branch 2 binds (DTA-heavy or loss-making company) — informational, not a data error.

tax_effect.consolidated_variant: 第百五十六条第二号: same with 実効税率 (3-year weighted) and an extra foreign loss-carryback term — applies to scope=group rows only

life.article: kokuji74 第八十一条 (via 第五十四条)
labels_ja: 罹患及び障害リスクの額

life.management_action_note: kokuji75 注 6(3): the MA row shows the increase/decrease of the parent already reflected inside the sub-amounts (each sub is computed with MA per 第四十六条) — NOT a separate subtraction after sqrt. Recompute parent = sqrt(x^T R x) of the subs as printed.
life.omission_rule: kokuji75 注 2(7): 損害保険会社 may omit the life sub-rows when 生命保険リスク is immaterial (both FY2025 samples: rc_life dash, rows absent)
life.sample_status: no life sample yet (NN Life not_yet) — matrix taken from the notice, reproduction untested; kics_item_ref 29~34 candidates

nonlife.article: kokuji74 第八十九条 (via 第八十二条) + 別表七; disclosed sub-level defined by kokuji75 注 3(2)
labels_ja: 賠償責任保険類似の商品に係るリスクの額
自動車保険類似の商品に係るリスクの額
財物保険類似の商品に係るリスクの額
その他保険に係るリスクの額
regulation_steps: 1. per (地域区分 × 商品区分): 保険料リスク and 支払備金リスク aggregated with ρ = 0.25

2. per (地理的区分 × 商品大区分): the step-1 amounts of the 商品区分 in that 大区分 aggregated with the 別表七 uniform ρ: 財物保険類似 0.50 / 賠償責任保険類似 0.50 / 自動車保険類似 0.75 / その他保険 0.25 (不動産ローン保証保険·信用保険 excluded — they sit in 不動産リスク 第百十九条 / 信用リスク 第百二十八条第三号)
3. per 地理的区分: the four 商品大区分 amounts aggregated with ρ = 0.50 (uniform)
4. across 地理的区分 (日本 / EEA等 / 米国·カナダ / 中国·その他): ρ = 0.25 (uniform)
nonlife.disclosed_sub_definition: kokuji75 注 3(2): each printed sub = step-2 amounts of that 商品大区分 aggregated ACROSS geographies with the step-4 ρ = 0.25 (order differs from the regulation's step 3→4)
nonlife.exactness: sqrt(x^T R x) of the printed subs equals rc_nonlife ONLY for single-geography (Japan-only) companies (steps 3 and 4 then commute). Multi-geography companies (indicator: rc_cat_nat_foreign > 0 or foreign business) will not reproduce — record the gap, do not treat as a parse error.

catastrophe.article: kokuji74 第百条 (via 第九十条); nat-cat 第九十二条·第九十三条; disclosed sub-level kokuji75 注 4(2)-(4)
labels_ja: 巨大自然災害リスクの額
その他の巨大災害に係るリスクの額
catastrophe.regulation_note: 第百条: 巨大自然災害 / テロリズム / 感染症 / 信用及び保証 の4額を ρ = 0.00 で統合. kokuji75 注 4(4): その他の巨大災害 row = the three non-natural amounts aggregated with the same ρ = 0.00, so rc_catastrophe should equal sqrt(rc_cat_natural² + rc_cat_other²) exactly (before the MA row, which is informational per 注 6(3)).

natural_cat.japan_rule: 第九十三条第一項: 地震·風水災·雪災 のペリル区分ごとの合計額を ρ = 0.00 で統合
natural_cat.foreign_rule: 第九十二条第二号: 地理的区分ごとに 正味既経過保険料 × リスク係数 (EEA等 40% / 米国·カナダ 50% / 中国·その他 30%)
natural_cat.cross_geography_rule: 第九十二条 柱書: 地理的区分ごとの額を『適切な方法により統合』 — no ρ specified in the notice
natural_cat.observed: Meiji Yasuda Non-Life: sqrt(546²+1447²+374²)=1591.2, +156 (simple sum) = 1747.2 vs printed 1748 → company uses simple addition for Japan+foreign; hypot would give 1598.8 (fails)

market.article: kokuji74 第百二十七条 (via 第百一条); selector 第百十二条
labels_ja: スプレッドリスクの額
market.selector: case_up if spread-risk (上昇ストレス) >= spread-risk (下降ストレス) else case_down. kokuji75 注 5(3): the printed row label becomes 『スプレッドリスク（上昇）の額』 or 『（下降）の額』 — read the label; plain 『スプレッドリスクの額』 with a dash/0 → both cases coincide.
market.management_action_note: same as life: informational row, subs already net of MA

credit.definition: simple sum: Σ 各信用エクスポージャー (EAD × リスク係数) + 特別勘定契約分 + 信用保険分 — no correlation matrix, no sub-rows in the form

recompute_chain: top_sqrt = sqrt(x^T R_top x), x = [rc_life, rc_nonlife, rc_catastrophe, rc_market, rc_credit]
rc_tax_effect_calc = 0.80 × t × (top_sqrt + rc_operational + rc_mgmt_action_excess)  [branch 1, t = assumed 0.28 — verify K/J]

G03_op_cap.formula: rc_operational <= 0.20 × (top_sqrt + G) + 1; at_cap flag when within 1

G04_tax_branch1.formula: rc_tax_effect <= 0.80 × t × (top_sqrt + F + G) + 1 (upper bound, always); implied_t = K / (J − I) / 0.80 reported

G05_market.formula: rc_market == sqrt(x^T R_mkt x) (case by spread label)

G06_nonlife.gate: only when single-geography (rc_cat_nat_foreign in (null, 0)); otherwise informational

G08_natcat_japan.formula: rc_cat_natural == sqrt(Σ jp perils²) + rc_cat_nat_foreign + rc_cat_nat_other (observed simple sum across geographies)
G08_natcat_japan.gate: informational (cross-geography method unspecified in 第九十二条)

G09_post_tax_chain.formula: rc_post_tax vs rc_post_tax_calc (t assumed) and esr_pct vs esr_calc

G10_life.gate: only when life sub-rows are printed

calc_method_rule.standard / standard_implied: all G-checks expected to reproduce within tolerance (except the structural exceptions above: G06 multi-geography, G08 cross-geography nat-cat)
calc_method_rule.internal_model: kokuji74 第六章 / kokuji75 注 4(2): an approved internal model replaces the standard 巨大自然災害 (and possibly other) amounts, and the disclosed subs are model outputs → G06/G07/G08 (and G05/G10 if the model covers market/life) are NOT expected to reproduce. Top-level G01/G02/G04 still use the notice matrix (第百五十五条 applies to internal-model users too) and remain gated.
calc_method_rule.usp (会社固有のストレス係数 / リスク係数): changes the sub-amount inputs, not the matrices → all G-checks still apply
calc_method_rule.census_link: docs/domains/claude-agent-jp.md §4b-4 calc_method column: when a company fails G06/G07 and its T8 section says 内部モデル手法 適用 → expected; when it says 該当ありません → record as deviation for follow-up
